ordinary_reference.why: Forces the unpacked generic M1 kernel (_gated_delta_kernel, simd_sum, one SIMD group per value row) so MLX_GDN_PACKED cannot swap the reference; MLX_GDN_CORE only affects gated_delta_update, which is not used. Both variables are recorded.

gate_design: Native-only, synthetic, recurrent-state scope: conv window, cache commit, real model, serving and performance remain pending; no cache operation is performed.

Admission fails closed without --i-own-the-gpu, an explicit MLX2_INTAKE_SOURCE_COMMIT, the default GPU device, Metal availability, device and build identity, and identical source hashes before and after the run. The flag is an operator acknowledgement only; lease and lock ownership come from the reviewed /tmp/mlx2-intake/stage3_gpu.py wrapper's receipt, not from this script.

Cases: singleton, width 2, chain, branch, forest, short-after-wide (width 32 immediately followed by width 2) and a fixed width-32 tree; bf16 and fp32 activations; head geometries Hk16/Hv48 (Qwen3.8-27B GDN), Hk2/Hv4 and Hk1/Hv2; B1, D128; run one case at a time.
Per case: one sparse forward launch and one replay launch per row (every root-to-node accepted path). The ordinary reference runs one token per call along each path.

Comparisons are full raw storage bits (bf16 as uint16, fp32 as uint32) with dtype and shape: every forward readout row against the ordinary readout at the end of that row's path, and every replayed state against the ordinary state. No allclose, and no shared host step.

Refusals: missing, partial or duplicate cases, rows or paths; dtype or shape mismatch; any non-finite value; unconfirmed engagement on any launch; confirmed-launch count different from expected; missing identity or ownership acknowledgement; source hash change. Bit differences, signed zero included, are counterexamples.

Root guidance 2877/2879: candidate and reference are compared on their returned dtypes and full storage bits with no normalization; matching non-finite values and an all-zero (vacuous) reference refuse; case, row and path identities are derived from the case matrix and checked for missing and duplicates.

The receipt records the explicit MLX2_INTAKE_SOURCE_COMMIT label separately from a verified git revision (source_commit_status) and binds runner, candidate, reference and provenance file hashes before and after. It must be paired with the parent wrapper's ownership receipt; --i-own-the-gpu is not lock or CPG proof.

Root pre-review 2882: every required hash (sources before, after import, after the run; metallib) must be 64 lowercase hex; scripts/paired_direct_ab.py (build-identity helper) is hashed; candidate, reference and identity-helper module files must resolve to this checkout; sources and git are captured before the native backend imports anything and re-hashed right after import, and identity problems refuse before any case runs.

Root follow-up 2885: every non-dict case or row entry refuses; row ids, paths, parents, Hk/Hv and confirmed-launch counts must be plain int (bool, float and numpy scalars refuse, never coerced). main refuses missing or invalid source hashes, a git HEAD that differs from MLX2_INTAKE_SOURCE_COMMIT, unavailable git status and dirty bound files BEFORE the native backend factory runs; a git status failure is recorded as unknown, never as clean. A frozen export without git remains an explicit unverified label, with hashes and module bindings mandatory.
